question: Does the National Library of China Research Institute's 2023 first-party retrospective provide a new institutional count-level control for the Tieqin Tongjian Lou transfer program, and can that control identify the target 3482/3483 volume's transaction mode?
answer: Yes for a new modern institutional retrospective control; no for target-item identification. In Ma Tao's 《王重民与鼎新之际的国家图书馆》, published by the National Library of China in 《文津流觞》2023年第4期, printed p.18 sits within the section 珍贵典籍的搜访与整理 and the paragraph describing Wang Zhongmin-era holdings growth through government-allocated precious materials. The first-party PDF text layer directly exposes a contiguous Qu-family cluster: 江苏瞿氏铁琴一张、铁琴铜剑楼匾额1方、善本书20种及收购书190种. This provides a National-Library institutional retrospective that places a 20-title rare-book component and a 190-title purchased-book component adjacent to the Qu/Tieqin objects. It independently strengthens the already-closed collection-level mixed-transfer proposition. However, it is a 2023 retrospective rather than a contemporaneous accession ledger; it gives no individual title list, batch date, accession number, price ledger, 3482/3483 identifier, 03482/03483 identifier, or 1823 Huang/Shiliju one-volume fingerprint. The exact grammatical/object scope of the 20 and 190 counts should therefore remain collection-cluster level and must not be promoted to an item-level transaction ledger.
